_comment: Vol 37 (Austin / West Side, ~4000-6000 W) -> modern renames. VOLUME-SCOPED. Source: 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25), carrying the 1913 consolidation ordinances. Each entry was spot-checked against the sheets. Numbered courts alias only via the direction-qualified full string ('N 42ND CT'); bare numbered keys are safe here because no south-side numbered street enters the volume bounds. Since normalize rejoins a split ordinal, the ordinal twins ('41ST'/'42ND'/'43RD'/'53RD'/'N 51ST'/'S 51ST') catch the spaced-ordinal reads ('N. 41 ST. AV.'); the bare halves '41'/'42 ND'/'43'/'53'/'N 51'/'S 51' now decide no read in this volume and are kept inert rather than deleted. A spaced-ordinal COURT read DOES reach the numbered-court keys, because the full-string alias lookup runs before the court guard ('N. 51 ST. CT.' -> LEAMINGTON). 'PARK AV' keys the full string so 'S. PARK AV.' (no documented range) stays unmatched.
_comment2: Deliberately NOT aliased: S. 40TH CT. (Komensky out of bounds), N. 43RD CT. (Lowell out of bounds), S. PARK AV. and PARK PL. (no documented range), S. 51ST CT. (S range undocumented), Oak Park's own grid incl. OAK PARK AV./SAYRE AV. (reference is Chicago-only), and junk reads. NO LONGER in that class, 2026-07-26: HENRY, filed by the step-2 record under 'no documented mapping found' as one of the 'HENRY (CORNELIA)'-style dual reads - Martin documents '-Henry St., Walton St. 5800 to 5999W', which is this volume's Austin span, and the file already aliased CORNELIA->WALTON. POPLAR->LOTUS is a documented rename the manual pass did not reach, not a reversed disposition. Both were auto-written by the sweep's clean tier; the rest of the dual-read tail stands.
_comment3: 2026-08-03: three entries re-pointed after the landing control was aimed at the shipped normalizer. PARK AV was END and is MAYPOLE; N PARK was WALLER and is PARKSIDE; SOUTH BOULEVARD was LAKE and is CORCORAN. Every read reaching each entry was projected through its page's committed fit: 32 of 32 rows are INDEPENDENT (no fit rested on the new target) and land at a 0.7-6.6 m median against 65-141 m for the old ones. The old targets were not half-right - the 22 reads that correctly reach END are spelled 'WEST END AV.' and get there without an alias. Locality alone had already preferred PARKSIDE and held it under the sweep's margin.
